decisions.reason: Its own website page is a visible public commitment, and a piqué upholstery fabric close to the core offer has had only one season to prove itself, so weak early sales can still be put down to temporary causes.
It is only mentioned, so commitment is modest, but a bouclé-effect sheer fits current trends and the firm's collection logic, and one year is too short to write it off.

A flame-retardant jacquard serves contract and hospitality customers, carries a certification investment, and is featured on its own page, so dropping it would write off sunk costs and contradict the firm's announced focus on functional fabrics.

A double-face wool blend builds on the established offer and uses the renewable materials central to the firm's sustainability direction, which gives management reason to persist despite only a light public commitment.
The wool bouclé leno ties into the announced shift to renewable materials, so management is likely to give it more time even though it is only mentioned on the website.
